question: does ramapo have an accounting society or something like that and how do i join
answer:
Yes. The Accounting Club is open to all students interested in accounting. It introduces accounting opportunities and careers, and holds networking and leadership events with professionals. Email accountclub@ramapo.edu to ask about joining. [2][3]

Ramapo also has an Association of Latino Professionals for America (ALPFA) chapter, focused on professional development and leadership for Latino and underrepresented students pursuing business, accounting, finance and related careers. Email alpfa@ramapo.edu. [8]

You can also explore clubs on Archway at archway.ramapo.edu. [10]

The Center for Student Involvement oversees clubs. Contact: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [6]
